'''Port Roberts''' is a floating platform found in the [[Western Ocean]], which is under the jurisdiction of [[Great Kourend]]. Level 50 Sailing is required to dock at and Charter to Port Roberts.

==Transportation==
There are several methods to quickly reach Port Roberts: 
* [[Sailors' amulet]] - Requires interacting with the [[Sailors' marker]] in the eastern side of Port Roberts
* Docking at the western side of the port by [[Sailing]] with a [[boat]]
* Take a [[Charter ship]] to Port Roberts (requires an initial visit via other method to unlock).

==Marketplace thieving==
Port Roberts features a market which contains 9 different stalls which players can [[Thieving|thieve]] from. Unlike regular stalls, all stalls here do not deplete when players thieve from them; however, players can only steal from a stall every 5 [[ticks]] instead of every 2. Furthermore, players will automatically thieve after clicking a stall until another action is taken, or the player is caught by a guard.

Roaming the stalls are 3 [[Market Guard (Port Roberts)|Market Guards]], which unlike regular [[guards]] cannot be attacked or interacted with in any way. The guards look at every 3rd stall for 10 ticks, and then move to the next stall in a clockwise rotation. If the player tries to steal from, or is in the middle of thieving, a stall which has a guard approaching it or looking at it, they will be caught and moved to the Port Roberts jail. Even if in the line of sight of a guard or stall owner, players are not caught unless thieving from a stall that a guard is looking at.

In the jail, players can picklock the gate to leave, or bribe the guard who will ask for up to 500 coins. You can use the [[Sailors' amulet]] to avoid picking the lock or using coins.

Assuming a guard has just left a stall, a stall can be thieved 4 times before a guard will be looking at the stall again. In this time, another stall can be moved to and thieved 2 times. If thieving from the [[cannonball stall]] 4 times and from the [[Ore stall (Port Roberts)|ore stall]] 2 times without any tick loss, players will gain 254,800 experience per hour. At level 65, the [[Spice stall (Port Roberts)|spice stall]] and [[Silver stall (Port Roberts)|silver stall]] is around 97,000 experience per hour and 100,000 coins per hour if selling to the shops and hopping worlds.

==Charter ship==
*After completing the [[Cabin Fever]] quest, the price between two locations, as displayed below, will halve the charter costs to 50%.
*The [[Ring of Charos(a)]] also halves the charter costs to 50%.
**These cost reductions can be combined to reduce the costs to 25%.
*Keep in mind the variance between destination fares. Similar to a layover, chartering to another destination first or using a non-charter ship like from [[Port Sarim]] to [[Musa Point]] can net significant savings. For example, the 2,900 coins cost to travel from [[Port Phasmatys]] to [[Brimhaven]] can be reduced by first chartering to Musa Point for 1,100 coins, then to Brimhaven for 200 coins.
**The only exception to this is [[Port Tyras]], which has the same fare to and from every other port.
